newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kangaroo does time in German police cell.
newsitem.headline: Kangaroo does time in German police cell.

text.p: A pet kangaroo found itself in a police cell overnight after escaping from its Hamburg home, German police reported on Friday.
Police captured the animal late on Thursday and put it behind bars as a temporary measure before transporting it to a local animal park.
The kangaroo was later reunited with its owners, police said in a statement.
